title: File:Orsières. Campanile della chiesa di San Nicola.jpg
claims: The image shows the stone bell tower of the Church of San Nicola in Orsières, part of the church facade at left and a pale mountain slope at right under a clear blue sky.
The Commons file title identifies the bell tower in Orsières; it contains no OCC, UTMB or race-day context and is a location photograph.

The author is André Corboz (1928–2012); the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the original is 3,000 x 2,053 pixels and 515 KB; the date is 1991-07-23; the source is the Iconoteca dell'Accademia di architettura, Fondo André Corboz.
The route page uses a 960 x 657 thumbnail of 125,270 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution and share-alike are required.
